title: Maintainer
brief: Read as the engineer who will own this code in a year. Can you tell why it is correct without running it? Would a small change in the requirement be a small change in the code? Prefer the version with fewer special cases and fewer things to remember. Documentation that restates the code earns nothing.
notes: A maintainer lens ranks code that already passed execution. It does not rule on correctness; that is the execution official's job.
